description: Free, no payment. Fetches one paid-call receipt by id from the rail's public receipts feed, to confirm a call was paid and delivered. Use to verify a genesis402_prove receipt or any paid call later. Read-only and idempotent. Returns the receipt as JSON, or an error with the HTTP status if the id is not found.

receipt_id.description: The receipt id exactly as returned with a paid call result or by genesis402_prove, 4 to 80 characters.

name: genesis402_receipt

receipt.description: The receipt exactly as published on the rail's receipts feed.

receipt_id.description: The id that was looked up.

title: Look up a receipt (free)
